title: ws-pause-state (server to app)

scope.description: run: the joined participants of the run; session: the owner and the viewers of the Session.

by.description: User ID of the member who paused or resumed.

description: Sent to every connected device of every member when the shared pause changes. A device that connects while paused receives paused=true. The pause lives in memory and ends with the Session or when the run has no joined member left. The run status paused of the run lifecycle is unrelated.
